editorial:
Imagine a world where the classic fairy tales you know are actually totally wrong. That is exactly what you get here. You follow Loopy, a wolf who claims he is actually the hero of the Little Red Riding Hood story. Instead of being a villain, he tells us how he tried to save Red's basket from those sneaky Three Little Pigs. The whole vibe is wacky, colorful, and full of that old-school cartoon energy that makes you feel like a kid again. It is a funny spin on a story you have heard a million times, turning the bad guy into a clumsy guy just trying to do the right thing.

The best part is the physical comedy and the way the characters bounce around the screen. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the jokes feel a bit dated. If you love classic animation, you should definitely check this out. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go to keep those bright colors forever.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with Loopy showing that he was not the monster everyone thought. After fighting off the Three Little Pigs and getting beat up in the process, he ends up winning over Grandma. Instead of eating her, he actually charms her with his personality. The twist is that the pigs were the real troublemakers all along. Loopy finishes his story feeling proud of himself, even though he looks like a total mess.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and funny twists on fairy tales.
